PRODUCT OPINION RESEARCH, INC.
ARTICLE I
Stockholders' Meetings
The annual meeting of the stockholders of the Corporation
shall be held on the fourth Wednesday in April in each year
(beginning in 1968). If that day is a legal holiday,the
annual meeting shall be held on the next succeeding day not
a legal holiday.
All meetings of the stockholders shall be held at the
time and place fixed by the Board of Directora. The time
and place shall be stated in the notice of the meeting.
Meetings of the stockholders shall be held whenever called
by the President, by a majority of the Directors or by stock-
holders holding at least 1/10 of the number of shares of
Capital Stock entitled to vote then outstanding.
